# Copilot Instructions — Kelas XI RPL 1 Website

## Project Overview

A static HTML/CSS/JS website for class XI RPL 1 (RPL = Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak, Software Engineering) at SMK PGRI 2 Ponorogo. Six-page application displaying school schedule, student/teacher lists, gallery, videos, and student mottos.

**Key characteristic:** All content is centralized in a single `data.js` file; the site reads from it, so modifications are data-only, not code.

## Architecture

### Single-Source Data Pattern
- **data.js** — Central data file containing all content: `SITE`, `MOTIVASI`, `GURU`, `SISWA`, `JADWAL`, `PIKET`, `GALERI`, `VIDEO`, `MOTTO`
- **script.js** — Shared logic for all pages; reads from data.js and renders UI dynamically
- **style.css** — Unified stylesheet (all 6 pages share one CSS file)
- **HTML pages** — Minimal markup; mostly containers with `id` attributes that script.js populates

### Page Structure
Each HTML file:
1. Includes inline theme preference script in `<head>` (prevents flash of unstyled content)
2. Sets `data-page` attribute on `<body>` (e.g., `data-page="beranda"`, `data-page="siswa"`)
3. Includes common header, tabbar, modal, and footer (script.js populates these)
4. Defines page-specific containers with IDs like `jadwalList`, `siswaGrid`, etc.

### Data Flow
```
data.js (SITE, GURU, SISWA, etc.) 
    ↓
script.js (init* functions read from data.js)
    ↓
DOM elements (populated with innerHTML or createElement)
```

## Key Conventions

### Data Field Names in data.js
- **Never rename fields** (e.g., `nama`, `jabatan`, `mapel`, `foto`, `seed`) — only change their values
- Structure:
  - `GURU` array: objects with `id`, `nama`, `mapel`, `jabatan`, `foto`
  - `SISWA` array: objects with `id`, `nama`, `jabatan`, `hobi`, `catatan`, `foto`
  - `JADWAL` object: `{ ganjil: { Senin: [...], ... }, genap: { ... } }`
  - `PIKET` object: `{ Senin: [...nama...], Selasa: [...], ... }`
  - `GALERI` array: objects with `id`, `caption`, `foto`, `seed`
  - `VIDEO` array: objects with `id`, `youtubeId`, `judul`, `deskripsi`

### Naming Conventions
- **Function names:** camelCase, prefixed with `init` for page initialization (`initBeranda`, `initSiswa`)
- **CSS classes:** kebab-case (`.site-header`, `.piket-chip`, `.sched-row`)
- **Data IDs:** lowercase with prefix (`g01` for guru, `s01` for siswa)
- **File paths:** lowercase with hyphens (e.g., `foto/siswa/nama-siswa.jpg`)

### Theme System
- Inline script in every `<head>` reads theme from localStorage (`xirpl1-theme`) or system preference
- Theme button toggles `data-theme="dark|light"` on `<html>` root
- CSS uses `[data-theme="dark"] { ... }` to style dark mode

### Week Parity Logic
- `getISOWeek()` calculates ISO week number; odd weeks = 'genap' (even schedule), even weeks = 'ganjil' (odd schedule)
- Terminology: "minggu ganjil" (odd week) = genap schedule, "minggu genap" (even week) = ganjil schedule
- This is intentional per school curriculum; do not change the calculation logic

### Photo Fallback System
- Every person/gallery item attempts to load from `foto/` folder
- On error, falls back to:
  - Students/teachers: avatar generated by `avatarUrl(nama, bg, color)` (uses `ui-avatars.com`)
  - Gallery: placeholder from `picsum.photos` (seed-based)
- Field `foto` in data objects overrides default path; change only if needed

## File Operations

### Adding Content
1. **New student/teacher:** Add object to `SISWA`/`GURU` array in data.js (copy structure of existing entry)
2. **New photo:** Place in `foto/siswa/`, `foto/guru/`, or `foto/galeri/` with exact name from `foto-manifest.md` or `foto` field
3. **New schedule/piquet:** Modify `JADWAL` or `PIKET` objects in data.js
4. **New gallery photo:** Add to `GALERI` array in data.js (update `seed` or `foto` URL)
5. **New video:** Add to `VIDEO` array with YouTube ID

### Code Changes
- **UI logic in script.js:** Functions like `initSiswa()`, `initGaleri()` render respective pages
- **Styling in style.css:** Single file; search by class name (e.g., `.siswa-grid` for student list layout)
- **Header/footer/modal in script.js:** Shared utilities; see `initNav()`, `initFooter()`, `initModal()`

### Helper Functions (script.js)
- `avatarUrl(nama, bg, color)` — Generate avatar URL from initials
- `photoTag(person, bg)` — Render `<img>` with fallback to avatar/placeholder
- `imgTag(src, fallback, alt)` — Safe image tag with error handling
- `openModal(html)` — Show modal with HTML content
- `getISOWeek(date)` — Calculate ISO week number

## Navigation & Responsive Design

### Pages
- **beranda (index.html)** — Home: class info, today's schedule, piquet, motivational marquee
- **siswa.html** — Student list (grid of cards with name, role, hobby)
- **guru.html** — Teacher list (grid of cards)
- **galeri.html** — Photo gallery (lazy-loaded grid)
- **video.html** — YouTube video embeds (grid layout)
- **motto.html** — Student mottos (vertical list with scrollable display)

### Responsive
- Tabbar (nav) collapses to hamburger menu on small screens
- Grid layouts (students, teachers, gallery) adapt 1→2→3+ columns
- Modal is full-screen on mobile, centered on desktop

### Active Tab
- Script reads `data-page` from `<body>` and marks matching `.tab` with `.active` class

## Common Tasks

### Update class info (school name, class name, etc.)
→ Edit `SITE` object in data.js (fields: `schoolName`, `className`, `majorName`, `totalStudents`, `totalTeachers`, `waliKelas`)

### Add/remove motivational quotes
→ Edit `MOTIVASI` array in data.js; marquee auto-renders all entries

### Change dark mode colors
→ Search `[data-theme="dark"]` block at top of style.css; modify color values

### Add new page
→ Create new HTML file with structure matching existing pages; add corresponding `initNewPage()` in script.js; link in tabbar; set `data-page` on `<body>`

### Lazy-load gallery photos
→ Gallery already uses `<img>` tags; photos load on demand. To use actual images instead of placeholders, update `GALERI` items with real URLs in `foto` field or place files in `foto/galeri/`.

---

**No build, test, or deploy commands** — open index.html directly in browser or deploy entire folder to static hosting (GitHub Pages, Netlify, etc.).
